proposed_replacement:
Hi Troy and Ron,

Please coordinate directly with Tyson and the Onesta team to have the necessary crew onsite Monday, October 26, and complete the remaining Carney/Onesta work no later than end of day Tuesday, October 27.

These items have been raised repeatedly and remain outstanding. Based on our earlier discussions, my understanding was that the remaining work required approximately one to two days. We need this work completed now so it does not cause further delays to inspections and opening.

Please confirm by 9:00 AM PT Monday:
1. Who will be onsite and when, including the electrician.
2. The completion date for each outstanding item.
3. Any specific blocker or information needed from me.

Please proceed with all work that does not depend on the landlord's stair work or inspection in parallel. If any item is at risk of missing Tuesday's deadline, please identify it immediately and explain how you will resolve the issue.

I remain available to provide access or clarify any items promptly. My priority is to finish the work and move forward with inspections and the CO.

Thank you,
Bharath

Progress work not dependent on landlord stairs/inspection in parallel.
